title: Planning Grandma’s Family Appreciation Lunch
script: Rania: [warmly] Iqbal, Grandma has helped our family so much. I want to arrange a simple appreciation lunch for her.
Iqbal: That sounds kind. Have you asked what kind of family visit she enjoys?
Rania: She often says she misses having the cousins together for a quiet meal.
Iqbal: [thoughtful] Good. Let us ask her directly instead of making it a surprise she may not enjoy.
Rania: I agree. She chose next Saturday and asked for a small group at her house.
Iqbal: What should we organize first?
Rania: [practically] I will confirm the cousins she invited. Can you make a list of the food?
Iqbal: Yes. We should also ask about allergies and dishes that are easy for her to eat.
Rania: I want us to cook two of her recipes and bring one meal from a nearby shop.
Iqbal: [warmly] That shares the work and keeps the kitchen from becoming too busy.
Rania: Could you collect short thank-you notes from the cousins?
Iqbal: I can. I will put them in a simple folder, not read them aloud unless Grandma wants that.
Rania: [pleased] Good. She likes personal words but does not enjoy being the center of a loud event.
Iqbal: Who will help clean after lunch?
Rania: I made three teams: food, serving, and cleaning. Grandma should not need to manage us.
Iqbal: [approving] That is real appreciation—making the day easier, not giving her more work.
Rania: We will take photos only after asking everyone.
Iqbal: Good. Care includes consent and privacy.
Rania: [hopeful] I want the lunch to feel calm, useful, and full of gratitude.
Iqbal: It will. Let us send the clear plan tonight.

quiz.question: What does Rania want to arrange?
quiz.explanation: The meal thanks Grandma for her care.
